newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen falling on selling pressure.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen falling on selling pressure.

text.p: Shares on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) may fall amid a correction when the market reopens after Thursday's public holiday and Friday weekend, brokers said.

"The market is stabilising through the on-going correction. The steep rise over the past several sessions was mainly due to euphoric trading by small invetsors and not backed by sound fundamentals," broker Sabbir Ahmed said.

Investors were expected to continue booking profit and they would wait for the market to stabilise before making fresh commitments, brokers said. The DSE price index closed 233.2 points or 6.39 percent down at 3,415.54 on on Wednesday.
